editorial:
Imagine moving your family to a quiet seaside town for a fresh start, only to find out the locals are hiding some dark secrets. You follow a security expert who thinks he can keep his loved ones safe, but everything changes when a young woman is attacked. Suddenly, his professional skills aren't enough to stop the chaos unfolding around him. The movie feels like a slow burn that quickly turns into a race against time, leaving you wondering who you can actually trust when the people in charge are the ones lying to your face.

The acting is solid and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the plot move a bit slowly, the payoff is worth the wait. If you enjoy mysteries that make you think, you will love this one. It is a perfect pick for a rainy weekend night.
endingExplained: You discover that the attack was not a random crime but part of a bigger cover-up involving powerful local people. The security expert uses his skills to uncover the truth, leading to a final showdown where the real villains are exposed. After a tense fight, the bad guys are brought to justice, and the family finally finds the peace they were looking for, though they are forever changed by the trauma.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves small town mysteries and plot twists.
